verdict.rationale: Steel's core Sessions API spins up isolated, on-demand browser instances each with their own state, cookies, and storage, and this isolation was independently verified via a self-hosted runtime probe that created a live, separate browser session from a throwaway Docker instance — effectively a sandbox with no shared production state. Missing for 10: explicit documentation framing sessions as a 'test vs production' environment, and no first-party guidance on staging/production data separation policies beyond session isolation.
